dataset: WBDS -- a public dataset of overground and treadmill walking and running
citation: Fukuchi CA, Fukuchi RK, Duarte M. A public dataset of overground and treadmill walking kinematics and kinetics in healthy individuals. PeerJ 2018;6:e4640. doi:10.7717/peerj.4640.
record_used: subject 01, one time-normalized (101-point) gait knee angular-speed cycle -- one of the same knee-speed curves the functional-regression (wbds-fda) case uses; treated as a movement speed profile at a nominal 100 Hz.
pipeline: readRDS(knee_speed_cycle) -> PhysioMoCap::sparc (Spectral Arc Length) and PhysioMoCap::ldlj (log dimensionless jerk). The reference re-computes both with an independent Python reimplementation of the Balasubramanian et al. (2015) smoothness toolbox, via reticulate, and computes SPARC on a fixed-seed noise-corrupted copy for the construct check. The walking-speed trend is computed across all 328 curves. Deterministic.
note: This is a CROSS-TOOL AUDIT of two shipped ops (PhysioMoCap::sparc, ldlj) -- not new ops; they had never been certified against the canonical reference. Both reproduce an independent Python reimplementation of the Balasubramanian et al. (2015) reference algorithm BIT-FOR-BIT (max |diff| ~4e-16 for SPARC, ~1e-14 for LDLJ) -- the identical deterministic closed forms (FFT-spectrum arc length; jerk integral). Construct check: adding noise to the speed profile makes SPARC more negative (-1.64 < -1.63), confirming the metric detects reduced smoothness as designed. Across the WBDS walking speeds the knee-speed cycle is smoothest at moderate speeds and less smooth at the fastest (speed-smoothness correlation -0.26), consistent with movement smoothness peaking near preferred speed. HONEST: the input is a time-normalized cycle analysed at a nominal 100 Hz, so the SPARC/LDLJ values describe the cycle shape rather than an absolutely-timed reaching movement; the op-vs-reference agreement is exact regardless. SPARC and LDLJ are the standard movement-smoothness metrics in neurorehabilitation (stroke recovery, ataxia, reaching quality).
